shared_elements: one hand raised holding an object
single figure composition on a vertical panel
justification: Both panels show a single large standing figure in profile, rendered in low relief with intricately carved pleated garments and one arm extended holding an object, giving a superficially similar processional composition. However, the specific iconography differs sharply: A depicts a winged, eagle-headed composite being holding a bucket and cone within a floral/rosette border under an inscription band, while B shows a fully human guard wearing a crenellated crown and gripping a long vertical spear, with no wings, animal features, floral framing, or text.
